hero_copy.label: Hero introduction
hero_copy.value: I'm Haley Reeder, an instructional designer specializing in learning design and development. I build learning for sales, partner, product, technical, customer, and marketing contexts, with additional experience in enterprise networking, AI evaluation, LMS operations, custom development, system integration, workflow automation, reporting, and communications.

featured_intro.label: Featured work introduction
featured_intro.value: My portfolio is organized around instructional design, AI training and evaluation, and the systems and workflows that support learning development and operations.

hero_title.label: About hero title
hero_title.value: Learning design, development, and the systems around it

hero_intro_primary.label: Primary introduction
hero_intro_primary.value: I've designed learning across education, corporate L&D, technical and commercial enablement, and AI evaluation. My recent work focuses on enterprise learning for sales and partners, product launches, technical foundations, and customer support, alongside LMS operations, analytics, workflow automation, project management, and custom digital content.

hero_intro_secondary.label: Background paragraph
hero_intro_secondary.value: Before corporate L&D, I taught high school history and English. That classroom experience and my Master of Education continue to shape how I use learning theory, practice, feedback, assessment, and performance evidence.

approach_intro.label: L&D approach introduction
approach_intro.value: I start with the performance need, design for useful practice and feedback, and build measurement and maintainability into the solution from the beginning.

thread_heading.label: Common thread heading
thread_heading.value: How I apply L&D across different kinds of work

thread_intro.label: Common thread introduction
thread_intro.value: The deliverable changes, but the learning questions stay consistent. Select a project type to see how I adapt learning theory, design decisions, and evidence to the format.

hero_intro.label: Projects hero introduction
hero_intro.value: Explore examples of instructional design, AI training and evaluation, and the workflows and systems that support learning development, delivery, measurement, and maintenance.

family_intro.label: Project types introduction
family_intro.value: Each area includes practical examples, interactive demonstrations, and reusable approaches to learning and performance work.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I design and develop learning from analysis through measurement, including interactions, multimedia, assessments, pathways, reference tools, and performance support.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: I begin with the learner, the performance need, and the business context before choosing a format. The goal is to build the smallest effective solution that supports the required performance.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: Depending on the need, that may be a focused interaction, microlearning, multimedia asset, reference resource, assessment, certification pathway, or a connected learning ecosystem.

examples_intro.label: Examples introduction
examples_intro.value: Explore standalone learning experiences, multimedia development, and complete learning pathways.

hero_intro_primary.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro_primary.value: I evaluate AI-generated work against task requirements, source evidence, and quality standards rather than surface fluency alone.

hero_intro_secondary.label: Hero supporting paragraph
hero_intro_secondary.value: My work includes structured evaluation, analytical review, error detection, feedback writing, quality assurance, and testing AI within professional learning workflows.

overview_heading.label: Overview heading
overview_heading.value: Evaluation starts with requirements and evidence

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: A polished response can still be inaccurate, incomplete, unsupported, or misaligned with the task.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: I define the task, audience, source material, and success criteria before evaluating accuracy, completeness, instruction adherence, consistency, and usability.

overview_body_three.label: Overview paragraph 3
overview_body_three.value: I separate material quality issues from stylistic preference and focus feedback on problems that affect correctness, usefulness, or reliability.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I design the processes around learning work as carefully as the learning itself, from design and development workflows to LMS operations, AI integration, automation, reporting, and long-term content ownership.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: I use documented workflows to make design decisions, handoffs, reviews, and development easier to follow and repeat.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: I also automate repetitive work, connect content with LMS and reporting systems, and use AI where it improves speed or quality without removing review and ownership.

overview_body_three.label: Overview paragraph 3
overview_body_three.value: Documentation, versioning, analytics, and clear ownership keep learning products maintainable after launch and create evidence for continuous improvement.

areas_intro.label: Workflow areas introduction
areas_intro.value: Explore learning design, learning development, work automation, AI integration, LMS and content operations, and documentation and continuous improvement.

hero_intro.label: Contact hero introduction
hero_intro.value: LinkedIn is the easiest way to reach me. A protected portfolio contact form is also in development.

connect_intro.label: Connect card introduction
connect_intro.value: I'm interested in instructional design, learning technology, AI, enablement, and learning systems work.

form_intro.label: Contact form introduction
form_intro.value: This form will connect to a secure form service so my email address does not need to be published.
